Spec vs design conflicts that need an R3 decision: (1) Conflict banner: spec §3.8.12 has 'This file changed on the server. Your version was saved as "…".' with [Open your version] [Dismiss]; the editor-conflict design has '…while you were offline.' with [Compare] [Open conflicted copy] [x]. I built the design's actions and used the spec's quoted wording, with the offline headline only when the change happened offline. (2) The Files fallback chip reads 'Keyword search only — model loading' in the design but 'semantic model loading — showing keyword matches' in the spec (RAG-06); I used the spec string, since the e2e test asserts it. (4) The files-light notes say Enter renames (Finder style), while the spec and the semantic notes say Enter opens; I made Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+O open and F2 rename. (5) The design's '⌘N' hint for a new folder is browser-reserved; I show Ctrl+Shift+N (⇧⌘N on Mac).

Missing tokens: spec §4.4 names --pl-syn-*, --pl-term-*, --pl-ansi-0..15 and --pl-editor-active-line, but tokens.css defines none of them. The xterm theme (TERMINAL_TOKENS and ANSI_GREYS in ui/src/apps/terminal/theme.ts) and the CodeMirror syntax classes (CodeEditor.module.css) map onto existing text-safe tokens, flattened for contrast; xterm also runs with minimumContrastRatio 4.5.

@lezer/highlight is not a direct dependency, so the CodeMirror highlighter maps highlight tags by name (tag.set, most specific first) through a custom Highlighter, using only types derived from @codemirror/language.

Boundary issue: the kernel writes the confirmation block (§3.8.15), but the kernel cannot import @plotinium/ui. The pure ANSI helpers in ui/src/apps/terminal/ansi.ts (no DOM) can be used by apps/terminal and the gallery; if the kernel TTY writer is to share them, they must move to protocol/ or kernel/core/tty.

Not built (outside the listed scope or needing more input): the editor minimap; the Compare diff view (Compare only emits an intent); inline rename in Files (it emits 'rename'); drag and drop; the Columns and Gallery views (shown disabled in the switcher); true Menu submenus ('Open With…' opens a follow-up menu instead); the CodeMirror find panel (needs @codemirror/search); stopping the caret blink after 5 s idle (CodeMirror has no such option; the blink is off under reduced motion); and the glass decorations over the plan block (the block is ANSI text, as the spec requires).

Accessibility trade-off: the close 'x' on editor and terminal tabs is a pointer-only, aria-hidden span, because a button inside role=tab fails axe's nested-interactive rule. Keyboard users close a tab with Delete, which aria-keyshortcuts exposes.
